7039-the-angel-adjutant-of-twice-born-me.creator: Minnie L. Carpenter
7039-the-angel-adjutant-of-twice-born-me.description: A book by Minnie L. Carpenter. en sick body with its nights of sleeplessness--its days of pain. It conquered the worst in the worst of men whom she encountered in her work of mercy. It won a multitude of souls to believe in her and in her message, and then to believe in her Saviour. It was ever greater than her circumstances.

arxiv-2106-07728.title: Targeted Data Acquisition for Evolving Negotiation Agents
arxiv-2106-07728.creator: Minae Kwon, Siddharth Karamcheti, Mariano-Florentino Cuéllar, Dorsa Sadigh
arxiv-2106-07728.description: Abstract Successful negotiators must learn how to balance optimizing for self-interest and cooperation. Yet current artificial negotiation agents often heavily depend on the quality of the static datasets they were trained on, limiting their capacity to fashion an adaptive response balancing self-interest and cooperation.

arxiv-2310-02399.title: Can 5G NR Sidelink communications support wireless augmented reality?
arxiv-2310-02399.creator: Ashutosh Srivastava 1 2 , Qing Zhao 1 , Yi Lu 1 , Ping Wang 1 , Qi Qu 1 , Zhu Ji 1 , Yee Sin Chan 1 , Shivendra S. Panwar 2
arxiv-2310-02399.description: Abstract Smart glasses that support augmented reality (AR) have the potential to become the consumer’s primary medium of connecting to the future internet. For the best quality of user experience, AR glasses must have a small form factor and long battery life, while satisfying the data rate and latency requirements of AR applications.

arxiv-2311-01632.title: Nonlinear effects in Anderson localization of light by two-level atoms
arxiv-2311-01632.creator: Noel Araujo Moreira, Robin Kaiser, Romain Bachelard
arxiv-2311-01632.description: Abstract While Anderson is a single-particle wave effect, guaranteeing a single excitation in the system can be challenging. We here tackle this limitation in the context of light localization in three dimensions in disordered cold atom clouds, in presence of several photons.

arxiv-2402-06559.title: Diffusion-ES: Gradient-free Planning with Diffusion for Autonomous Driving and Zero-Shot Instruction Following
arxiv-2402-06559.creator: Brian Yang, Huangyuan Su, Nikolaos Gkanatsios, Tsung-Wei Ke, Ayush Jain, Jeff Schneider, Katerina Fragkiadaki
arxiv-2402-06559.description: Abstract Diffusion models excel at modeling complex and multimodal trajectory distributions for decision-making and control. Reward-gradient guided denoising has been recently proposed to generate trajectories that maximize both a differentiable reward function and the likelihood under the data distribution captured by a diffusion model.

arxiv-2407-12054.title: Ivancevic Option Pricing Model modulational instability through the variational approach
arxiv-2407-12054.creator: Christopher Gaafele
arxiv-2407-12054.description: Abstract The instability of the Ivancevic option pricing model is studied through the variational method. We have analytically derived the dispersion relation of the IOPM for both constant volatility and Landau coefficient model and time-dependent volatility and Landau coefficient model. Also the IOPM was studies numerically using the 4th order Runge-Kutta method.

arxiv-2510-13430.title: Evaluating Arabic Large Language Models: A Survey of Benchmarks, Methods, and Gaps
arxiv-2510-13430.creator: Ahmed Alzubaidi, Shaikha Alsuwaidi, Basma El Amel Boussaha, Leen AlQadi
arxiv-2510-13430.description: Abstract This survey provides the first systematic review of Arabic LLM benchmarks, analyzing 40+ evaluation benchmarks across NLP tasks, knowledge domains, cultural understanding, and specialized capabilities. We propose a taxonomy organizing benchmarks into four categories: Knowledge, NLP Tasks, Culture and Dialects, and Target-Specific evaluations.

arxiv-2510-18084.title: RL-Driven Security-Aware Resource Allocation for UAV-Assisted O-RAN in SAR Operations
arxiv-2510-18084.creator: Zaineh Abughazzah 1 , Emna Baccour 2 , Loay Ismail 1 , Amr Mohamed 1 and Mounir Hamdi 2
arxiv-2510-18084.description: Abstract The integration of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) into Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) enhances communication in disaster management and Search and Rescue (SAR) operations by ensuring connectivity when infrastructure fails. However, SAR scenarios demand stringent security and low-latency communication, as delays or breaches can compromise mission success.

pmc-10699047.title: We’re here too: child health information-seeking experiences and preferences of Red River Métis families – a qualitative study
pmc-10699047.creator: Lisa Knisley, S Michelle Driedger, Lisa Hartling, Frances Chartrand, Julianne Sanguins, Shannon D Scott
pmc-10699047.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundRed River Métis families need access to meaningful and appropriate resources when their children are sick. At the invitation of the Manitoba Métis Federation (MMF) to partner in this research, our aim was to understand Red River Métis parents’ experiences and preferences for seeking child health information when their child is acutely ill, to inform the adaptation of existing parent resources.MethodsA qualitative descriptive approach underpinned by a participatory paradigm guided this study.

pmc-10715509.title: British Society of Gastroenterology guidelines for the diagnosis and management of cholangiocarcinoma
pmc-10715509.creator: Simon M Rushbrook, Timothy James Kendall, Yoh Zen, Raneem Albazaz, Prakash Manoharan, Stephen P Pereira, Richard Sturgess, Brian R Davidson, Hassan Z Malik, Derek Manas, Nigel Heaton, K Raj Prasad, John Bridgewater, Juan W Valle, Rebecca Goody, Maria Hawkins, Wendy Prentice, Helen Morement, Martine
pmc-10715509.description: These guidelines for the diagnosis and management of cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) were commissioned by the British Society of Gastroenterology liver section. The guideline writing committee included a multidisciplinary team of experts from various specialties involved in the management of CCA, as well as patient/public representatives from AMMF (the Cholangiocarcinoma Charity) and PSC Support.

pmc-11384708.title: Designing and psychometric evaluation of safe nursing care instrument in intensive care units
pmc-11384708.creator: Mozhdeh Tajari, Tahereh Ashktorab, Abbas Ebadi, Farid Zayeri
pmc-11384708.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundProviding safe care in a sensitive and high-risk unit such as the ICU is one of the most crucial tasks for nurses. One way to establish the criteria for safe care is by creating a instrument to assess it. Therefore, this study was conducted with the aim of designing and psychometrically evaluating an instrument for safe nursing care in the ICU.MethodsThe current study employed a sequential-exploratory mixed-method approach with two qualitative and quantitative phases.

pmc-12396616.title: Cutaneous Chronic Graft-Versus-Host Disease: Clinical Manifestations, Diagnosis, Management, and Supportive Care
pmc-12396616.creator: Connie R Shi, Alana L Ferreira, Manjit Kaur, David Xiang, Jean Caputo, Hannah K Choe, Nada Hamad, Edward W Cowen, Benjamin H Kaffenberger, Emily Baumrin
pmc-12396616.description: Cutaneous chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD) is associated with morbidity, mortality, and impaired quality of life after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. The clinical features of cutaneous cGVHD are heterogeneous but can be broadly classified into nonsclerotic or sclerotic presentations. This review provides an overview of clinical presentation, diagnosis and differential diagnosis, grading, and treatment of cutaneous cGVHD.

pmc-12610532.title: Multi-Path Attention Fusion Transformer for Spectral Learning in Corn Quality Assessment
pmc-12610532.creator: Jialu Li, Haoyi Wang, Hongbo Zhang, Tongqiang Jiang, Antonio González-Casado, Chiara Roberta Girelli
pmc-12610532.description: Accurately modeling the nonlinear relationships between near-infrared (NIR) spectral signatures and biochemical traits in corn remains a major challenge. A key difficulty lies in capturing multi-scale contextual dependencies—ranging from local absorption peaks to global spectral patterns—that jointly determine quality constituents such as protein and oil. To address this, we propose SpecTran, a spectral Transformer network specifically designed for NIR regression.

pmc-13125253.title: Enterocytes rely on purine biosynthesis/salvage pathway to facilitate dietary fat absorption
pmc-13125253.creator: Yu Wang, Li Chen, Yingze Ma, Mingqi Zhou, Aleksander Geske, Marcus Seldin, Jiangjiang Zhu, Alexander M Zak, Xinzhong Dong, Robert N Cole, Svetlana Lutsenko
pmc-13125253.description: Dietary fat absorption is among the most energy-demanding processes of nutrient uptake. Fatty acid activation, triglyceride synthesis, and the trafficking of chylomicrons through the secretory pathway - all require ATP. How enterocytes accommodate the surge in ATP consumption following fat uptake is unclear.

pmc-13349947.title: Quantitative evaluation of key factors influencing hepatic oxygen saturation measurement by photoacoustic imaging in mice
pmc-13349947.creator: Wenyue Qin, Jiazhi Cao, Hong Wang, Wenwu Ling
pmc-13349947.description: BackgroundPhotoacoustic imaging (PAI) has emerged as a promising non-invasive technique for assessing hepatic oxygen saturation (sO2). However, systematic evaluation of its baseline characteristics and influencing factors in normal liver tissue remains limited. This study aimed to establish a standardized PAI protocol for hepatic sO2 measurement in normal C57BL/6 mice and identify key factors contributing to measurement variability.

pmc-13352864.title: Preliminary evaluation of the German SPIN and Mini-SPIN for screening social anxiety disorder in university students
pmc-13352864.creator: Teresa Schmidt-Peter, Leon O. H. Kroczek, Andreas Mühlberger
pmc-13352864.description: BackgroundEfficient screening for Social Anxiety Disorder (SAD) requires valid and up-to-date instruments. The Social Phobia Inventory (SPIN) is a widely used and internationally validated measure. The German version has been validated in clinical and community samples, with a cut-off score of 25 established in 2008.

pmc-13399858.title: Arthroscopic Repair of Radial Meniscal Tear Using Fibrin Clot Augmentation and “Hashtag” Style Inside‐Out Technique
pmc-13399858.creator: Siddharth Padmanabhan, Helena Franco, Peter Myers, Francois Tudor

pmc-13536381.title: The utility of 3D nanostructured polyglycolic acid fibers for novel bone regenerative medicine
pmc-13536381.creator: Itsuki Hayashi, Sayaka Nakamura-Yamada, Kojiro Abe, Eiji Ito, Wataru Katagiri, Tatsuhiko Miyazaki, Yoichi Yamada
pmc-13536381.description: Background/purposeAutologous and artificial bone grafts are widely applied for alveolar bone reconstruction. However, as concerns regarding invasiveness, safety, and efficacy persist, the improved novel regenerative materials are expected. This study focuses on the bone regenerative potential of three-dimensional (3D) nanofiber-based polyglycolic acid (nPGA), whose capacity for bone regeneration remains unclear.

uslaw-usc-t7-s2225d.title: 7 U.S.C. § 2225d — Availability of Department of Agriculture funds for temporary employment
uslaw-usc-t7-s2225d.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s2225d.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 55 (Department Of Agriculture). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. On and after November 10, 2005, funds appropriated by this or any other Appropriations Act to the Department of Agriculture (excluding the Forest Service) shall be available for employment pursuant to the second sentence of section 2225 of this title and section 3109 of title 5.
